# vappcloud_iam_group (Resource)

An IAM group and its complete user/service-account membership set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vappcloud_iam_group" "operators" {
  name       = "operators"
  member_ids = var.operator_principal_ids
}

variable "operator_principal_ids" {
  type    = set(string)
  default = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name, unique within the organization.

### Optional

- `member_ids` (Set of String) Complete set of user or service-account principal IDs in the group.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) Group ARN.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `id` (String) Opaque public resource identifier.
- `member_count` (Number) Current group member count.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp in RFC3339 format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vappcloud_iam_group.operators group-id
```
